protocol.formula: R=clip((0.5-H)*200,0,100); T=0 if abs(s)<0.5 else clip(s,-10,10)*10; signed=R*T/100; edge=max(0,signed)
protocol.hurst: Existing R/S on 252 closing prices' log increments; frozen implementation hash
protocol.ranks: Training-only 1/3 and 2/3 quantiles per score; equality belongs to lower bucket; never split ties
protocol.entry: Next session close after signal; exit h sessions after entry
protocol.drawdown: Worst peak-to-trough decline on daily closes including entry and exit; negative percent
protocol.bootstrap: Paired circular time-block bootstrap, block=ceil((h+1)/5), 2000 replicates, seed=54; exploratory 95% intervals
protocol.primary_comparison: High edge-K return minus high trend-only return at 21 sessions, with mean drawdown no worse; require 95% return-difference interval above zero and >=20 non-overlapping observations in both groups
protocol.promotion_rule: Never promote on reused historical data; prospective independent replication required
protocol.freshness: K-specific held-out evaluation only. These dates were examined in other studies; not a genuinely untouched holdout.
protocol.scope: SOXL single-symbol temporal ranks, not cross-sectional investment rankings
